title: Conflict normalization is required before opening dispute
detail: Disputes cannot open without definition, scope, and quantifier alignment; most apparent conflicts dissolve in normalization.
fix_hint: Complete definition, scope, and quantifier alignment via POST /v1/sessions/:id/conflicts before asserting conflict.

example.aligned_definitions: Both claims define S_k(x) as the truncated sum of divisor powers.
example.aligned_quantifiers: For all eps > 0, there exists N_0.
example.smallest_disagreement: Whether the error term is bounded by O(x^{1/2+eps}) or Omega(x^{1/2} log x).
